name: The Meditation Realm
description: A still-water realm between planes where Ugin meditated and where Bolas killed him.

timeline.summary: The original plan fails and Jace is unmade in the Meditation Realm, but pieces linger and rebuild him with the need to build a better Multiverse.
timeline.quote: When our original plan failed, Jace was unmade in the Meditation Realm.

timeline.summary: In the memory, Jace shapes a body from the Meditation Realm, imitating Ugin, and pours his fractured selves into it.
timeline.quote: shaping a body from the inherent power of this place and pouring his fractured selves inside.

pages_say.description: A still-water construct between planes where Bolas claims he killed Ugin.
A still-water realm between planes where Ugin meditated and where Bolas killed him.
The realm where Jace was unmade and began constructing the new reality.
The realm where Jace was lost and may have put himself back together.
The place that held Jace's shattered selves together and let him craft a body.
